items.source: Parses Anthropic rate-limit response headers as documented at Anthropic rate limits. Beyond the request and token families exposed through the RateLimit contract, this class also surfaces the Anthropic-specific input-token and output-token buckets via dedicated getters.
items.translation: 解析 Anthropic 速率限制响应头，具体文档请参考 Anthropic 速率限制。 除了通过 RateLimit 接口暴露的请求和令牌系列外， 该类还通过专用 getter 方法提供了 Anthropic 特定的输入令牌和输出令牌桶。
